recipes.name: Greek yogurt berry bowl
recipes.instructions: Combine yogurt and dry oats. Add berries and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Chicken rice bowl
recipes.instructions: Weigh chicken, rice and broccoli after cooking. Combine and add olive oil.

recipes.name: Eggs and toast
recipes.instructions: Weigh eggs without shells before cooking. Cook without additional fat, toast bread and serve with banana.

recipes.name: Tuna potato bowl
recipes.instructions: Drain tuna, weigh cooked peeled potatoes and raw tomatoes. Mix with olive oil.

recipes.name: Turkey wrap
recipes.instructions: Weigh cooked turkey, then fill the tortilla with turkey, vegetables and yogurt.

recipes.name: Salmon dinner
recipes.instructions: Weigh all three ingredients after cooking. Do not add oil unless separately counted.

recipes.name: Chicken potato plate
recipes.instructions: Weigh the cooked chicken, peeled boiled potatoes and cooked broccoli. Plate and drizzle with measured olive oil.

recipes.name: Turkey rice bowl
recipes.instructions: Combine weighed cooked turkey and rice with diced tomatoes; add measured olive oil.

recipes.name: Salmon rice bowl
recipes.instructions: Cook salmon thoroughly. Weigh cooked salmon, rice and broccoli, then serve together.

recipes.name: Egg and potato breakfast
recipes.instructions: Cook weighed eggs in a nonstick pan without added fat. Serve with boiled peeled potatoes and sliced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Yogurt banana oats
recipes.instructions: Combine yogurt and oats. Add sliced banana and weighed peanut butter.

recipes.name: Tuna rice salad
recipes.instructions: Drain and weigh tuna. Toss with cooked rice, washed lettuce, tomatoes and measured oil.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla wrap
recipes.instructions: Fill tortilla with weighed cooked chicken, lettuce, tomato and yogurt.

recipes.name: Salmon and tomato potatoes
recipes.instructions: Serve cooked salmon with boiled peeled potatoes, tomatoes and measured oil.

recipes.name: High protein egg toast
recipes.instructions: Cook eggs without added fat; serve with toast and yogurt.

recipes.name: Banana blueberry yogurt
recipes.instructions: Combine yogurt, sliced banana, blueberries and measured peanut butter.

recipes.name: Turkey potato salad
recipes.instructions: Combine weighed turkey, boiled potatoes, vegetables and measured oil.

recipes.name: Chicken broccoli rice
recipes.instructions: Serve weighed cooked chicken, rice and broccoli. Do not add uncounted oil.

recipes.name: Tuna tomato toast
recipes.instructions: Mix drained tuna with yogurt; spread over toast with sliced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Egg rice bowl
recipes.instructions: Scramble eggs without added fat and serve with cooked rice and broccoli.

recipes.name: Peanut banana oatmeal
recipes.instructions: Cook oats in water and top with banana, peanut butter and yogurt.

recipes.name: Turkey broccoli potatoes
recipes.instructions: Serve weighed cooked turkey, boiled peeled potatoes and cooked broccoli.

recipes.name: Salmon broccoli plate
recipes.instructions: Serve weighed cooked salmon with broccoli and rice.

recipes.name: Blueberry overnight oats
recipes.instructions: Mix oats and yogurt; refrigerate overnight and add blueberries and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon overnight oats
recipes.instructions: Dice the apple and combine all ingredients in a covered jar. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight; stir before serving.

recipes.name: Strawberry almond yogurt bowl
recipes.instructions: Slice the strawberries and roughly chop the almonds. Spoon yogurt into a bowl and top with dry oats, berries and almonds.

recipes.name: Spinach mushroom egg toast
recipes.instructions: Slice mushrooms and cook in the measured oil for 5 minutes. Add spinach, then beaten eggs and stir until the eggs are set. Serve on toasted bread.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese pear bowl
recipes.instructions: Dice the cored pear and roughly chop walnuts. Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl and top with pear, dry oats and walnuts.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
recipes.instructions: Blend banana, dry oats and weighed egg into a batter. Brush a nonstick pan with the measured oil and cook small pancakes over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until set. Serve with yogurt and blueberries.

recipes.name: Breakfast bean burrito
ingredients: Black beans (cooked, drained, no added salt)
recipes.instructions: Dice pepper and cook in oil for 4 minutes with cumin. Add spinach and beaten eggs; stir until set, then warm the drained beans in the pan. Fill the warm tortilla and roll.

recipes.name: Peanut strawberry porridge
recipes.instructions: Simmer oats with milk and water for 5–7 minutes, stirring. Stir in chia and top with sliced strawberries and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Chickpea quinoa crunch salad
recipes.instructions: Use cooked, drained chickpeas and cooked quinoa. Dice cucumber and tomato; toss with quinoa, chickpeas, measured oil and lemon juice. Crumble feta over the bowl.

recipes.name: Black bean quesadilla
ingredients: Black beans (cooked, drained, no added salt)
recipes.instructions: Mash half the drained beans and stir in diced pepper and cumin. Fill the tortilla with beans and cheese; fold and toast in a dry pan for 3 minutes per side until hot and the cheese melts. Serve with diced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken quinoa bowl
recipes.instructions: Use cooked chicken and quinoa. Dice cucumber and tomatoes and slice chicken. Mix yogurt with lemon juice and spoon over the assembled bowl.

recipes.name: Tuna white bean salad
ingredients: White beans (cooked, drained, no added salt)
recipes.instructions: Drain tuna and beans thoroughly. Chop the vegetables and toss with beans, tuna, lemon juice and measured oil.

recipes.name: Tofu edamame rice bowl
recipes.instructions: Pat tofu dry, cube and brown in a nonstick pan without extra oil for 8–10 minutes. Warm cooked rice and shelled edamame. Whisk peanut butter, lemon and water into a sauce and serve with tofu, grated carrot and sliced cucumber.

recipes.name: Turkey avocado sandwich
recipes.instructions: Mash avocado with yogurt and spread on bread. Add sliced cooked turkey, tomato and washed lettuce; close and cut in half.

recipes.name: Lentil feta grain bowl
recipes.instructions: Use cooked quinoa and drained cooked lentils. Finely dice pepper and slice spinach. Toss with grains, lentils, lemon and measured oil; finish with crumbled feta.

recipes.name: Chicken hummus-style wrap
recipes.instructions: Mash chickpeas with yogurt and lemon juice. Spread onto the tortilla, then add sliced cooked chicken, grated carrot and lettuce. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.

recipes.name: Shrimp avocado quinoa bowl
recipes.instructions: Use thoroughly cooked peeled shrimp and cooked quinoa. Dice avocado and vegetables and arrange over quinoa. Toss shrimp with lemon and measured oil and add to the bowl.

recipes.name: Lentil tomato pasta
ingredients: Tomatoes (canned, no added salt, with juice)
recipes.instructions: Cook pasta according to its pack and weigh the cooked portion. Finely chop onion and garlic, soften in oil for 5 minutes, then add canned tomatoes and cooked lentils and simmer 10 minutes. Wilt in spinach and toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Lemon cod tray bake
recipes.instructions: Slice zucchini and garlic and roast with half the oil at 200°C for 15 minutes. Add cod and the remaining oil and roast until fish reaches 63°C; weigh the cooked fish portion. Serve with weighed baked sweet potato flesh and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Chicken pepper fajita bowl
recipes.instructions: Slice pepper and onion and sauté in oil for 7–8 minutes with paprika and cumin. Add sliced cooked chicken and heat until steaming hot throughout. Serve over cooked brown rice with yogurt.

recipes.name: Smoky bean sweet potato
ingredients: Black beans (cooked, drained, no added salt)
recipes.instructions: Start with a baked sweet potato; weigh the cooked flesh for the listed portion. Warm drained beans with diced tomato and paprika for 5 minutes. Spoon over the potato and add diced avocado and yogurt.

recipes.name: Salmon quinoa greens
recipes.instructions: Bake salmon at 200°C until it reaches 63°C and weigh the cooked portion. Steam broccoli and cook quinoa, then weigh both cooked portions. Plate with salmon and drizzle with measured oil and lemon juice.

recipes.name: White bean tomato skillet
ingredients: White beans (cooked, drained, no added salt)
Tomatoes (canned, no added salt, with juice)
recipes.instructions: Dice onion and garlic and soften in oil for 5 minutes. Add drained beans and canned tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted and serve with toasted bread.

recipes.name: Tofu peanut whole wheat noodles
recipes.instructions: Cube and brown tofu in a dry nonstick pan for 8–10 minutes. Steam carrot strips and broccoli until tender and cook pasta, weighing the cooked portions where listed. Whisk peanut butter, lemon and water and toss everything with the sauce.

recipes.name: Chickpea spinach tomato stew
ingredients: Tomatoes (canned, no added salt, with juice)
recipes.instructions: Dice onion and garlic and soften in oil for 5 minutes with cumin. Add drained chickpeas and canned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted and serve over weighed cooked brown rice.

recipes.name: Warm lentil vegetable soup
ingredients: Tomatoes (canned, no added salt, with juice)
recipes.instructions: Dice carrot, zucchini and onion and soften in oil for 5 minutes with cumin. Add water, canned tomatoes and cooked drained lentils and simmer for 15 minutes until the carrots are tender. Serve with whole wheat toast.

foodFunctions.recipeSource:
function recipeSource(r){if(!r.inspiration)return '';const ref=r.inspiration==='quesadilla'?['https://www.nutrition.gov/recipes/black-bean-quesadilla','USDA Nutrition.gov']:r.inspiration==='balanced'?['https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/eat-well/how-to-eat-a-balanced-diet/eight-tips-for-healthy-eating/','NHS balanced eating guidance']:['https://www.nutrition.va.gov/Recipes/Vegetarian_Recipes.asp','VA Nutrition recipe collection'];return '

An original EZPZ recipe, inspired by '+ref[1]+'. Ingredients and portions adapted for EZPZ.

'}
foodFunctions.nutrition: function nutrition(ingredients,scale=1){const values=[0,0,0,0];for(const [name,grams] of ingredients){const row=foods[name];if(!row||!Number.isFinite(grams)||grams<0)throw Error('Missing nutrition reference: '+name);row.forEach((v,i)=>values[i]+=v*grams*scale/100)}return values.map(Math.round)}
foodFunctions.mealPhoto: function mealPhoto(i,hero=false){const photo=recipes[i].photo||(i<6?'./meal-images/meal-'+i+'.jpg':null);return photo?'':''+mealIcons[i]+''}
foodFunctions.plannedNutrition: function plannedNutrition(date){const day=plannedMeals()[date]||{},totals=[0,0,0,0];for(const slot of ['breakfast','lunch','dinner']){const i=day[slot];if(Number.isInteger(i)&&recipes[i]){const scale=planPortion(day,slot);for(const [name,grams] of recipes[i].ingredients){foods[name].forEach((v,k)=>totals[k]+=v*grams*scale/100)}}}return totals.map(Math.round)}

foodFunctions.updateRecipe:
function updateRecipe(i){const r=recipes[i],scale=Number(document.querySelector('[data-serving="'+i+'"]')?.value||1),n=nutrition(r.ingredients,scale),grams=Math.round(r.ingredients.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+x[1]*scale,0)*10)/10,out=document.querySelector('[data-nutrition="'+i+'"]'),list=document.querySelector('[data-ingredients="'+i+'"]');if(out)out.textContent=grams+' g total ingredient weight';const headline=document.querySelector('.meal-detail .detail-eyebrow');if(headline)headline.textContent='EZPZ RECIPE · '+grams+' G INGREDIENTS';const portionLabel=document.querySelector('.meal-detail>p');if(portionLabel)portionLabel.textContent=(r.minutes?r.minutes+' min prep · ':'')+scale+' × serving';const kcal=document.querySelector('[data-kcal="'+i+'"]'),macros=document.querySelector('[data-macros="'+i+'"]');if(kcal)kcal.textContent=n[0];if(macros)macros.textContent='P '+n[1]+' g · C '+n[2]+' g · F '+n[3]+' g';for(const [key,v] of [['protein',n[1]],['carbs',n[2]],['fat',n[3]]]){const el=document.querySelector('[data-'+key+'="'+i+'"]');if(el)el.textContent=v+'g'}if(list)list.innerHTML=r.ingredients.map(([food,g])=>'
  • '+safe(food)+''+Math.round(g*scale*10)/10+' g
    • ').join('')}
